day_shape: 66 items: Axios-sourced report that Netanyahu is pressing Trump to strike Iran after US midterms, UK MTO reports a ship struck in the Strait of Hormuz, Qatari-mediated US-Iran talks continue in Doha, Khamenei orders 'target bank' update, Iran International logs 88.7% inflation; nothing from UK Parliament, State Department or OFAC.

threads.label: Netanyahu-Trump post-midterms strike reporting
threads.summary: Iran International, citing Axios, reported Netanyahu is pressing Trump to strike Iran immediately after Tuesday's midterms while Trump wants negotiations to continue. Jerusalem Post and Times of Israel reported Israel is prepared for a joint US strike, a Trump–Netanyahu phone call on Saturday, and Democrats leader Yair Golan opposing Netanyahu leading another war.

threads.label: Qatar-mediated US-Iran nuclear talks
threads.summary: Iranian negotiators were in Doha for a third consecutive day of Qatari-mediated talks, per Jerusalem Post, while Iran International reported Iran rejected nuclear negotiations and demanded its war-ending conditions. Foreign Minister Araghchi said consultations on a 'two-day plan' continue without a final conclusion, and that Iran is prepared for defence or diplomacy depending on 'American rationality.'

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz ship strike report
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press relayed a UK Maritime Trade Operations notice that a ship in the Strait of Hormuz was struck by an unidentified projectile. Defa Press separately reported an explosion in Jizan, explosion sounds in Kuwait, and air-raid sirens in Khamis Mushait and Abha following what Saudi media described as an attack from Yemen.

threads.label: Khamenei 'target bank' and deterrence messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted that the armed forces' 'target bank' should be updated to put all American-Zionist assets within reach, and framed regional dynamics as architecting a new West Asia order. Defa Press carried Law Enforcement commander Radan saying the target bank is being updated, adviser Makhber describing 'borderless deterrence,' and a claim Iran's missile posture is reshaping regional equations.

threads.label: Iran economy and domestic pressure
threads.summary: Iran International reported year-on-year inflation at 88.7%, public schools demanding payments from parents, seizure of a Tehran art school's assets, and self-immolation accounting for 16% of burn admissions. IRIB and Defa Press reported Pezeshkian prioritising economic resilience and low-income livelihoods, a 1405 budget revision, and a 500,000-toman fall in domestic gold prices.

threads.label: IDF operations and Lebanon-Gaza security
threads.summary: The IDF said troops located weapons in a civilian home and a children's room with Hezbollah symbols in Al-Khiam, southern Lebanon, while Jerusalem Post reported Lebanon's Military Court charged 13 Hezbollah members over a half-ton explosives shipment. Jerusalem Post also reported a new Israeli policy granting immunity to senior Hamas governmental officials in Gaza, and Defa Press reported nine Palestinians killed in Gaza strikes.

threads.label: IRGC counter-espionage and Russia claims
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB reported that IRGC Intelligence's 'Anonymous Soldiers of Imam al-Zaman' arrested an alleged spy accused of leaking locations of drone and missile parts production centres in Central Province. Jerusalem Post reported an IRGC spokesperson claimed Russian Su-35 fighter jets were meant to arrive before the US–Iran war began.
